## Fence check, done before dispatch rather than left to the dev

⚠️ This card sits next to the **#9465 epic fence**, so I resolved it rather than hand you the ambiguity:

- #9465's body (*"Migrate the release toolchain to @changesets/cli v3 — one atomic PR"*) **never names `scripts/collect-release-notes.sh`** — checked by reading the body, not by inferring from the title.
- **No open PR anywhere in the repo touches that file** — all 29 open PRs enumerated at claim time.
- The fence's actual members stay out of scope for you regardless: `.changeset/**` *config* and changeset scripts, `cut-rc.yml`, `release.yml`, `pr-automation.yml` **changeset steps**, root `package.json`.

⇒ Cleared to proceed on `collect-release-notes.sh` itself. If your own reading finds the file inside the fence after all, **stop and report it** rather than pressing on — I would rather be corrected than have you work around me.

## Same-day churn

`scripts/collect-release-notes.sh` was touched by **PR #10506** (#9902), which guarded **section 4** of the same script. Sync against **current `origin/main`** before editing — main has moved repeatedly today, including the #10811 p0 landing at ~12:2xZ.

## Standing constraints

- ⛔ Governed, human-merge-only: `docs/adr/**`, `.claude/**`, `skills/**`, `AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md` — propose wording in the report.
- ⛔ Never edit `content/docs/releases/**`. This card is release *tooling*; the release *pages* are written centrally at release time.
- ⛔ Never `git stash` — `refs/stash` is shared by every worktree of the repo.
- ⚠️ A pipe swallows the exit code: capture as `cmd > log 2>&1; ec=$?`.
- ⚠️ Changeset gates pass vacuously against an **uncommitted** changeset.
- ⭐ **The p0 that was red all afternoon is fixed** (#10807 → PR #10811, merged): `git-history --self-test` used bare-date approxidates whose edge swept a fixture commit once a day. If you touch anything date-shaped in this script, spell **complete instants** (`2026-06-20T00:00:00Z`), never bare `YYYY-MM-DD` — `collect-release-notes.sh --self-test` already spells its window that way and is the in-repo precedent.

Report back to me; I review against GitHub and land it.
